baseline_user_reported_failure.provenance: user-provided fixed-boundary run result in current task

method.operator: same finite-difference Delta-star operator as the existing fixed-boundary screen
method.flux_surface_q: toroidal-flux derivative from solved psi surfaces using radial ray intersections
method.inverse_update: q_design <- q_design / (q_solved / q_target), clipped to 15 percent per iteration
method.toroidal_precompensation: 1 + 0.20 rho^2, inferred from reported 1.0-to-1.2 q drift
method.diagnostic_caution: Suydam and s-alpha values are local proxy diagnostics from this module's continuous radial-ray surfaces; cross-check against the project's exact independent diagnostic before promotion.

baseline_same_operator_q_drift.provenance: recomputed with this correction module's toroidal fixed-boundary operator

correction_profile.current_profile_derivation: j_phi from d/dr [2 pi B0 r^2 / (mu0 R0 q_design)]

tf_ripple_screen.scope: exact finite-segment Biot-Savart TF-ripple screen; analytic interleaved screening topology

fixed_boundary_candidate.suydam_proxy_method: Suydam D = r Bphi^2/4 (d ln q/dr)^2 + mu0 dp/dr
fixed_boundary_candidate.ballooning_proxy_method: alpha = -2 mu0 R0 q^2 dp/dr / B0^2; alpha_crit = 0.6 |s|
fixed_boundary_candidate.pressure_label: supplied pressure profile interpolated by geometric rho
limitations: fixed circular boundary; no PF/shaping coil fit
prescribed geometric-rho j_phi and pressure, not a full p(psi), F(psi) closure
local large-aspect-ratio Suydam and s-alpha proxies, not eigenvalue stability
no 3-D free-boundary equilibrium or nonlinear MHD

mesh_convergence.purpose: Grid-resolution check for the corrected fixed-boundary toroidal equilibrium screen.
mesh_convergence.diagnostic_scope: The two runs use the same prescribed geometric-rho pressure/current model, finite-difference Delta-star operator, radial-ray flux-surface extraction, and local Suydam/s-alpha proxy definitions.

runs.source_report: independent rerun of Tomahawk_MHD_FixedBoundary_Correction.py at 201 x 201

mesh_convergence.interpretation: The corrected edge-q ratio and ballooning proxy are stable across the two grids; the minimum Suydam D remains positive. This supports numerical repeatability of this screening diagnostic, not qualification of the device or proof of a self-consistent free-boundary equilibrium.

remaining_blockers: PF/shaping coil geometry, currents, and engineering limits
self-consistent p(psi), F(psi), and plasma-current/current-drive closure
